resources.string: \tMycelium supports Bitcoin HD, Bitcoin Single Address, Ethereum, and ERC20 Accounts.\n\n\tAll Bitcoin HD, Ethereum, and ERC20 Accounts are created from the same Master Seed and can be restored from it (12 words that should be written down by you on paper and stored in a safe place).
In order to add a Single Address Account based on a private key or a read-only address, please click the Advanced button below.
Import Bitcoin address or private key from clipboard.
Create Master Seed from Word List

Only copy this key in a secure environment.
Anyone who has access to it gains control over all current and in the future available bitcoin for this account.

Long-press here to show the 
QR-Code

You are about to export sensitive data of the selected account.

Anyone who gains access to these keys can either take possession of the bitcoin it controls or gain information that might subvert your privacy.

Do you want to continue?

You should backup the master seed of your wallet.
A backup of your master seed allows you to restore your funds stored on your HD Bitcoin accounts if your device is lost or damaged.

Do you want to do this now?

Make a Backup of your Private Key!

It will take you 2 minutes but can save millions! Having a proper backup is a cornerstone when managing your digital assets or Bitcoin funds.

DO NOT USE Mycelium without creating and verifying backup of all your accounts - if you lose your smartphone and have no backup your bitcoins and digital assets will be lost forever.

Do you want to proceed?

Warning: Exporting the private account data to your clipboard exposes it to all other apps on your device.

Note: It is not enough to store your private data on the clipboard, you also have to paste it somewhere safe.

Archived accounts won\'t be monitored. That means you can not work with this account while having its label in your accounts list.

This feature adds privacy and security, keeping your balance and access to funds secure.

To activate archived account select it from accounts list "Archived" section, tap on the menu button in the top right corner of the screen and select "Activate".

You are about to back up your encrypted private keys to a PDF document.\nThe PDF document can safely be shared using email or with file-sharing apps you have installed, such as Dropbox. This is because your keys are encrypted.
This is the random password with checksum used for encrypting this backup.
This is your only opportunity for viewing the password for this backup.\nYour next backup will use a different password.\nWrite it down and keep it safe!

Your Mycelium wallet backup is attached.

Follow these simple steps to secure your funds:
1. Print the PDF document.
2. Write the 15-character password from the display of your Android device to the blue boxes of the printout.
3. Verify that you can import the private keys to your Mycelium Wallet.
4. Store the printout in a safe place.
You are about to decrypt a password protected private key.
Enter the 15 character password and checksum.

You are about to back up your master seed.

After making a backup you should set a PIN to prevent anyone that briefly holds your phone from making another backup and steal your current and future funds.

You will be shown a list of words, one after another. Write those words down using pen and paper, and store them in a safe place.
Please enter the words you just wrote down, one after another, to make sure that everything is backed up correctly.

WARNING - an additional backup is risky.

You already have exported your master seed before. If you have lost the old backup and you are not sure who might have access to it, it is very dangerous to continue to use this master seed.

Secure your funds by making your account "watch-only" 

 For security reasons, it is recommended to delete the private keys of accounts that store critical amounts for you from the device. This is only possible for SA (Single Address) accounts. For convenience, you can think of ‘SA’ as ‘Savings Account’.

 This account will be available for viewing only: you will be able to see the balance and transactions, but sending bitcoins won’t be possible.
Before deleting the private key, make sure you have its backup stored offline and in a safe place. You will have to \"add it back\" from backup when you need to spend the bitcoins from this account.
